note: THE 2026-08-26 (ROUND 7) RE-SHOOT, EXECUTABLE.
Round 6 shot C7/C9/C10/C11 BEFORE the fix that this PR's 'Acceptance item 3'
section describes. Every cell of that round is therefore stale, so all four are
re-shot here on the fixed head and three readings the fix defines are ADDED:
C10b (a run with NO recommendation park — the row closed and muted), C10c (a
run whose hold was DECIDED — the settled row), and C11b (the review step while
the run works — the placeholder with the spinning icon).
The runs are the app's own, asked for in the app's own chat with a real model
provider and created by the app's own dispatch. Nothing here inserts a run, a
trigger, a park, a gate or a record; every number is read back from the rows.
SIX RUNS, because one run cannot hold every reading at once:
- a run that arms a one-off AHEAD leaves the setup surface (its page becomes
the Trigger tab), so C7 and C9 are a BEFORE and AFTER of one press on ONE
run and C10b is shot on that same run before the press;
- the recommendation hold only fires for an agent that HAS a candidate skill,
so C10 (live hold) and C10c (decided) stand on a run of an agent that has
one, assigned through the app's own Matches tab;
- the review step needs a run that produced a reviewable artifact, so C11
stands on a run that ran to completion, and C11b on runs caught inside the
window between the artifact's outbox row and the gate the sweeper opens
from it (measured at 25 s and 5 s on this lane, which is why its two themes
come from two runs).

cells.name: run-setup-scheduling-step
cells.run: the setup run, before any press
cells.requires: the run-surface drawing's two-column clause — 'a step rail down the left NAMES the run's ordered steps, and the run detail on the right shows the selected step' — on the first-time run page, with the unchanged scheduling form ('When should this run?', the option rows, Estimated run duration, Continue) open in the RIGHT column and no agentic run progress card beside it (plan (A) 7.2 step 5). cinatra#2970 acceptance 1 and 4.

cells.name: run-setup-continue-armed
cells.run: the SAME run as C7, after Continue
cells.requires: cinatra#2970 acceptance 2, second half: 'Continue arms it exactly as today' — the same run's page after Continue was pressed on the scheduler step inside the run detail column, with a one-off armed ahead.

cells.name: run-setup-recommendation-step-opened
cells.run: a run with a LIVE recommendation hold
cells.requires: cinatra#2970 acceptance 3, first half — 'the skills-recommendation step ... opens the same way, to the right of the steps, never under a row' — and the fix on this head: 'the recommendation row opens exactly when the run has a live hold (the hold card)'.

cells.name: run-setup-recommendation-row-closed
cells.run: the SAME run as C7, which has no recommendation park
cells.requires: the fix's other half — 'closed+muted otherwise' — and the ruling's 'clicking it does nothing; the scheduler stays open; the right column never shows an empty step surface'. The press is FORCED because the row carries aria-disabled and Playwright's own actionability treats that as not-enabled: a row that is never pressed proves nothing.

cells.name: run-setup-recommendation-step-settled
cells.run: the SAME run as C10, after the hold was DECIDED on the card
cells.requires: the fix: 'the recommendation row opens exactly when the run has a live hold (the hold card) or a DECIDED one (the settled row)'.

cells.name: run-setup-review-step-opened
cells.run: a completed run with a review GATE on file
cells.requires: cinatra#2970 acceptance 3, second half, and the fix: 'the review row draws the run's review slot — the review card once a gate is on file'. Plan (A) 4.2.

cells.name: run-setup-review-step-working
cells.run: a run inside the window between its artifact's outbox row and its gate
cells.requires: the fix: 'the placeholder with the spinning icon while the run works'. Plan (A) 4.2 — 'a card ... with a spinning icon' — so it is graded on its anchor and its spinner, never on a text length.
